title: Single-Hunk Git Staging, Agent Turn Snapshots, In-Editor Find, and High-Throughput Search Optimizations
summary: Introduces single-hunk Git staging, unstaging, and discarding directly from diff views, automatic worktree turn snapshots with revert support in agent threads, in-editor find with line centering and hit navigation, auto-staging on commit, unborn HEAD and safe directory support, LSP inline diagnostics, decoupled internal packages, and multi-core search pipeline optimizations.

categories.name: Git & Diff Operations
items: Add single-hunk staging, unstaging, and discarding (gitApplyHunk) directly from the visual diff viewer
Support diff hunk context line expansion in both split and unified diff modes
Automatically stage unstaged modifications when committing without pre-staged files
Add safe git directory validation and cache verification in git probe
Support unborn HEAD states during repository branch detection, unstaging, and diffing
Return fresh git status payload directly from stage and unstage endpoints for immediate UI updates
Maintain static commit button text and prevent commit success flash state clobbering in git panel
Strip enclosing quotation marks when parsing AI-generated commit messages

categories.name: Agent Threads & Snapshots
items: Add worktree turn snapshot capture (gitSnapshotWorktree) and restore helpers for per-turn diff review and rollback in agent threads

categories.name: Editor & UI Capabilities
items: Add in-editor find bar (Cmd/Ctrl+F) with hit navigation, match count indicator, and viewport centering
Add word wrap support with dynamic line height measurement in the virtualized renderer
Expose LSP diagnostics with inline diagnostic badges in the editor interface
Streamline row rendering and gutter updates to minimize DOM reflows and memory allocations

categories.name: Performance & Architecture
items: Refactor codebase into decoupled internal packages (fuzzy, ignore, metrics, render, settings, symbols, telemetry, ui, update)
Add zero-allocation ASCII fold scanning and whole-file pre-filtering to bypass line splitting during full-text searches
Add preallocation and heap filtering to fuzzy search worker pipelines
Construct file tree index concurrently with git status resolution for faster cold startups
Consolidate forge provider subsystems into forge.go and LSP client subsystems into lsp.go
Cache static assets, LSP document handles, and git status snap states

categories.name: Testing & Tooling
items: Add unified test-bench verification runner (test-bench.sh) and Makefile targets for automated test and benchmark suites
Add micro-benchmarks across internal packages and workbench operations
Increase test coverage across fuzzy search, gitignore parsing, table delimiters, and error handling
Add build-web target in Makefile for streamlined frontend asset compilation
Simplify post-install instructions and getting-started examples for px0 CLI workflows

categories.name: Documentation
items: Update feature and internal documentation for single-hunk staging, auto-staging, and in-editor find
Document per-turn thread diff snapshots and rollback capabilities
Add documentation for internal subsystem testing, benchmarks, and decoupled internal packages
